feeds.title: Bake Play Smile
feeds.description: Well hello there gorgeous! I'm so excited to welcome you to Bake Play Smile… this is my happy little blissful foodie paradise full of salted caramel goodness, chocolate-laden desserts and pretty much anything covered in sprinkles! Oh and of course, there's a few healthy and savoury recipes thrown in for good measure too

feeds.title: Butter and Brioche
feeds.description: A blog featuring decadent, honest and traditional recipes, in particular, those of french baking. The blog features a collection of sweet recipes that weave tales of truth, of happiness, and love.

feeds.title: Baking Business
feeds.description: Owned and produced by TMPC, Baking Business is regarded as the nation's most-trusted baking industry publication and offers a behind-the-scenes look at the news and views affecting today's bakery businesses. Baking Business profiles successful bakeries, patisseries, and bakers leading the way, as well as the lowdown about the latest innovations set to hit the market.

feeds.title: Glenroy Bakery Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is all about the people, community and products that make our industry so fun and unique. Stay up to date with all the latest wholesale bakery news and analysis. Our fresh content is written for the modern baker, and for all of those working in our dynamic and eclectic industry. Starting out as a one-man operation, after almost 6 decades of operations, we are now one of the largest independent bread distributors in the Melbourne metro area.

feeds.title: Catherine Zhang
feeds.description: Discover dessert recipes with tips to help you achieve your baking goals. Whether they be fancy desserts or easy bakes Catherine brings them to you! I am Catherine Zhang. I'm a 21-year-old Australian-born Chinese running towards a future filled with desserts and pastry. I hope this space can provide you with the recipes, tips and ideas to bring you the happiness desserts bring me!

feeds.title: RecipeTin Eats » Baking
feeds.description: From the best-ever Chocolate Cake to Blueberry Muffins, the fluffiest and easiest Scones you'll ever have and irresistible Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies, if you're in the mood for baking, you're sure to find something here! I'm Nagi, and I'm the voice, cook, photographer and videographer behind RecipeTin Eats. My blog reflects my philosophy on food and cooking - fast, creative, clever and fresh.

feeds.title: A Baking Journey
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Sylvie, a Belgian Expat living in Melbourne, Australia. I am a passionate Baker who loves to share her favorite recipes and baking tips. Bake your way through life with inspired Recipes for all home bakers. Find your next favorite cakes, desserts, and baked goods here.

feeds.title: Baker's Treat Baking School Blog
feeds.description: Find Baking tips, tricks, reflections, ideas and inspiration for bakers across the globe from a baking school in Adelaide, South Australia. Established in 2013, we educate, equip and inspire people to bake at home and have lots of fun in the process! Matthew is a lifelong home baker and over decade-long professional baker; he's made batches of bread from one loaf to one thousand loaves.

feeds.title: Butter Baking by Natasha Ignatiadis
feeds.description: Butter Baking - A blog of baked goods by Natasha Ignatiadis. Melbourne based pastry chef. Custom cake creator.

feeds.title: The Business of Baking
feeds.description: The place where bakers find inspiration, motivation and education to help them taste sweet business success

feeds.title: BakeClub Blog
feeds.description: BakeClub makes baking easy, fun, inspiring and, above all, relevant to your busy life. Founded by Sydney-based food author, mum of two and passionate baker Anneka Manning, BakeClub is a baking school with a very big difference. It is more than a place where you will learn the basics of baking and use simple techniques to create baked goodies to die for.

feeds.title: PBCo. Blog » Recipes
feeds.description: Whether you find yourself at the beginning of your low-carb journey or you have been practicing low-carb for a while, we are here to help. Our Low Carb Recipes cover a range of topics for every occasion. The Protein Bread Company was founded to meet the needs of consumers who could not eat bread. Today, it allows thousands of athletes and health focused individuals to take it to the next level, with natural high protein, low carb & gluten free products that allow them to meet their daily nutritional requirements.

feeds.title: The Polka Dotter
feeds.description: I'm Salma, and I love creating beautiful images and sweet treats. If you're looking for a little baking inspiration, you've come to the right place. This blog is a place for me to share my favourite recipes and culinary adventures with you. If you love sweet treats as much as I do, you'll find yourself right at home here between naked cake layers and brownie corners, chocolate drizzles and salted caramel drips, tangy curds and buttercream swirls, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Wandercooks » Baking
feeds.description: Browse dozens of incredible baking recipes that will bring the warm, comforting experience of baking at home to your kitchen. From Easy Green Moussaka Bake to these sweet and fluffy Strawberry Muffins, decadent Coffee Scroll Biscuits to this aromatic French Spice Cake, you'll find all these and more and with simple step-by-step instructions and video tutorials! We're Sarah & Laura - here to inspire you with fresh new food ideas gathered from our favourite Asian, European and Australian cuisines.

feeds.title: Eat, Little Bird » Baking Recipes
feeds.description: A collection of easy and delicious baking recipes. Cakes, cookies, pavlovas, brownies - there is something here for every occasion! Included are birthday cake recipes and gluten-free cake recipes. My name is Thanh!I'm an Aussie living in Switzerland and I love to cook fast and easy meals for my family, using fresh and seasonal ingredients. Here you will find easy & delicious recipes with step-by-step photos for the perfect results.
